title: One full turn
description:
Write the turn logic of a small dungeon game: the player acts, then every monster, then the game checks for the end.

```
turn 4: player moves right, picks up a potion
         goblin attacks: hp 20 -> 17
         bat moves
turn 9: player attacks goblin: goblin dies, +10 xp
turn 15: player hp 0 -> game over, 3 monsters killed, 2 items found
```
hints: Reuse the pieces from the earlier projects in this milestone: walls, chasing and item effects (lesson 11.04).
Remove dead monsters after everyone has acted, so the list does not change while you loop over it.
requirements: A `Game` with the map, the player, monsters and items on the floor.
`turn(action)` for `move dir`, `attack`, `wait`, `use item`; then each monster acts.
The game ends when the player dies or every monster is gone; print a summary.
stretch: Add a debug console command that spawns a monster next to the player.
